philips_mx800.description: Bedside patient monitor for critical care settings with comprehensive hemodynamic monitoring

common_alarms.meaning: No breath detected for set time

quick_tips: Main menu: Press the Main Screen key at bottom left
Silence alarms: Yellow silence button on top right (mutes for 2 min)
Print strip: Press and hold the waveform you want to print
Change alarm limits: Tap the parameter box, select Alarm Limits

draeger_apollo.description: Anesthesia workstation for surgical procedures with integrated ventilator and monitoring

common_alarms.action: Check for obstruction, reduce tidal volume
Check O2 cylinder and pipeline supply

quick_tips: Standby mode: Hold Standby key for 2 seconds
Silence alarms: Press yellow Alarm Silence button
Change vent mode: Press Mode key, select desired mode
Fresh gas flow: Adjust O2 and Air knobs on front panel

bd_alaris_8015.description: Modular infusion system for IV medication delivery with drug library support

common_alarms.action: Open door, prime air out of line, restart
Check IV site, tubing, and clamps
Close and latch the pump door
Replace IV bag, prime if needed

quick_tips: Start infusion: Program rate and VTBI, press Start
Change rate: Press Channel Select, enter new rate
Bolus: Press Bolus key, set amount, confirm
Silence: Press yellow Silence button (2 min silence)

ge_b650.description: High-acuity patient monitor for OR and ICU with advanced hemodynamic capabilities
quick_tips: Home screen: Press Home button on front panel
Alarm limits: Touch parameter tile, select Limits
Freeze waveform: Touch and hold the waveform
NIBP measurement: Press NIBP Start button
